name: driftwood: bulk export of cart PII
note: A tier-3 op (needs an attested device) but below the patient-data ceiling. carried ~= £535k. A stale (out-of-currency) device is NOT denied outright here — it is dropped to a read-only/scoped session (caged), proportional to the £. Contrast ludlow-patient-data, where the same stale device is denied.
